description: Notes on water supply at Alice Springs is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. Existing sources of water supply are described. Proposals for improving the supply of town water are considered. Further investigations are recommended with respect to tapping the southern lobe of the local basin, surface conservation, underground water resources, and the selection of a possible dam site.
